description: MS Graph app-role abuse (e.g. Application.ReadWrite.All) - add credentials to a privileged service principal.

telemetry.detail: Entra ID audit log: 'Add service principal credentials (via Microsoft Graph app role)' (directory logging is default-on).
Unusual addition of credentials to an OAuth app.

prerequisite_privilege: A dangerous MS Graph app role (Application.ReadWrite.All, AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All, RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory)
abuse_primitive: Use the Graph app permission to add a secret to a Global-Admin-capable SP, then authenticate.
notes: Graph app-role paths are a top real-world Entra escalation; the credential-add is audited.
